title: A worker brief names a known whole-suite failure that is not a test, such as the seconds ceiling, so the worker files no duplicate bug
goal: backlog.py brief and dispatch take a known suite-level failure (--known-suite TEXT=BUG, e.g. the darwin seconds ceiling) beside --known TEST=BUG, print it in the brief's known failures section, and the worker rules say a listed failure gets no new bug; a brief made with it prints the line.
notes: Retrospective of SP-7n3d4jte (2026-10-12): the ST-b27c527d worker filed BG-6jaaptm6 for the darwin seconds ceiling although its brief's --probe named BG-ucwq6kga and BG-w6z2zc6r; --known takes only TEST=BUG, so the ceiling had to go in a free-text probe. Touches are a guess: the planner runs referrers on --known first.
